48 weeks = 48 × 7 = 336 days.  
Add 2 days → total 338 days.  
1510 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not by 400).  
From 1510-11-19:  
Days remaining in Nov: 30 − 19 = 11 → 338 − 11 = 327 left.  
Dec 1510: 31 days → 327 − 31 = 296 left.  
1511 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
Jan 31 → 265, Feb 28 → 237, Mar 31 → 206, Apr 30 → 176, May 31 → 145, Jun 30 → 115, Jul 31 → 84, Aug 31 → 53, Sep 30 → 23, Oct 31 → −8 → means date in Oct: 31 − 8 = 23.  
So 1511-10-23.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1511-10-23
